This location hasn't been discovered...yet!

SimplePlanes has a large, seamless world to explore with no loading screens in between.  Start from one of the available locations and fly around to discover the other islands.

When you spot one of the other large islands, make sure to fly there and unlock all the locations each island has to offer!
column2:
此地尚未被发现……

SimplePlanes 拥有一个巨大且无缝的世界，无需加载画面即可四处探索。从一个可选地点出发四处飞行，去发现其他岛屿。

当你发现其他大型岛屿时，一定要飞过去，并解锁该岛屿提供的所有地点！
